verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any native rule engine in Notion where a user defines an event trigger and an automatic action, such as database automations or agent triggers. Webhooks (notion-docs-3, notion-docs-20) and the REST API and internal connections described as 'ideal for custom automations' are developer building blocks for constructing such behavior, not the capability itself. The 'agents 24/7' and integration-directory marketing lines are too vague to evidence user-defined event rules.
